title: No scent
text: No scent. I love the lotus burner because you can burn either sticks or cones. The Incense sticks are small and come in a nice tubular case. The 2 scents that I got were Agarwood and the other was Sandlewood. Neither one has any scent to it when you open their tubes. I did light one anyways and it did have a very subtle scent that was nice and earthy.

product_metadata.title: Lotus Incense Holder Burner, Oriental Aroma Kodo, Censer Stick Incense Stick Holder Cone Incense Burner with Detachable Ash Catcher, Copper Alloy, U-MATE
features: Elegent Lotus Flower Shape Design：Lotus means purity and elegance in the oriental culture. The incense holder/burner comes with an elegant aesthetic 3-layer lotus flower design, showing both traditional and modern style which will be a great space decoration.

Exquisite Workmanship and Durable：This incense burner/holder is made of high quality brass alloy for long-term usage and durability. It is well made, comes with an excellent simple and classic color matching. It can catch falling ash as the incense burns away. The size: approx. 88mm/3.46inch in diameter and 13mm/0.51inch in height.

Widely Applicable for Various Kinds of Incense: This 6-hole burner/holder can fit with a variety and different size of incense such as Chinese incense, Southeastern Asian incense, Indian incense, Hem incense and Japanese incense, etc. It can be used as an aroma stove and applied with stick or cone incense.
Detachable Design: The upper stick holder can be detached from the base ash catcher. Therefore, it is very convenient to clean the residual.

Wide Application Occasions：This incense holder/burner is ideal for home, living room, yoga room, meditation room, reading room, bedroom, tea house, office, hotel, cafe, yoga, sauna, SPA, aromatherapy, meditation, etc. It is perfect for bringing a relaxing atmosphere to any space. It can also work as a great decoration even without the incense.
A Great Gift for Families and Friends：This incense holder/burner is a great gift for both families and friends. It can add more beauty to the space decor as well as relaxation and peacefulness.
Complimentary：2 tubes of oriental incense sticks, sandalwood and agarwood, will be shipped along with the product.
